title: await
description: Input schema for the lernie built-in `await` tool (ARCH §2.5, §3.3 — v0.4 Phase 3). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

handle.description: Subagent handle returned by an earlier `dispatch` call. The handle IS the subagent's full hyphenated descent / branch name (ARCH §2.2 / §2.3). `await` blocks until the named subagent reaches a terminal state (merged, stopped, or conflicted) and emits the outcome as `tool_result.content`.
